levels.surface: سليمان بن أحمد بن أيوب اللخمي

notes: «فيما كتب إلي من أصبهان» is the compiler's note on how the report reached him: no link
«عن أبيه» + name is one link (rule 7): the name alone is the surface
The last link is Ali, named inside the chain after «عن» (not an Imam in the words); the Prophet is the end
